headline: Bitcoin holds above $82.2k, eyes key resistance at $82.9k amid bullish expansion
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC is forming higher highs and remains above the 81,800‑82,000 support zone; the 4H view confirms a clean uptrend with liquidity accumulation near the 81,500‑82,000 area.
altcoin_summary: Altcoins are rotating into fresh risk, led by AMP (+15.8%), GTC (+13.1%) and KORUB (+12.5%), signaling capital flow from Bitcoin into high‑momentum tokens.
strategy_outlook: Spot: add on pull‑backs to ~81,800 with tight stops; Futures: go long near 81,800, stop below 81,500, target the 82,900 resistance.
